_comment: Pax weight configuration. Updated by reviewing pax_replay output and manually editing this file. Restart dashboard to pick up changes.

conviction_weights._comment: ib placeholder returns 0 always — redistributed its 5% to level so book reaction (fast component) gets 0.15. regime kept at 0.25 (top quant signal). bias/vwap/vp/slope/level all at 0.15 for balance.

conviction_halflife_sec._comment: Tuned for rotations. Old config (vp=600,vwap=420) was too slow — a 5-min rotation up only charged the VP EMA to ~30% of instantaneous, leaving composite stuck in MIXED/CHOP. New halflives let the score climb meaningfully within 2-3 min of a real move.

subgroup_overrides._comment: Per-subgroup multipliers applied AFTER regime boost. Populated by pax_replay --recommend after enough sessions of data.
